scenes.alt: One deliberately asymmetric paired situation: a warmly lit pediatric bed and caregiver occupy the left foreground; a distant industrial animal compartment occupies the right depth. Each is a material setting with a living subject, not two ECG cards. No gore, graphic wounds, suffering spectacle or actual medical procedure detail. The source comparison concerns evidence of distress, not identical experience. All settings are interpretive staging of fictional/composite source scenes, and later verdicts remain undisclosed.
